title: After the Oka Sho: This Doesn’t Feel Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Sweep Tosho's amazing performance causes a wave of excitement at the Oka Sho, the bulk of attention still goes to the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, when the runners on the Triple Tiara tour are gathered for an interview concerning their future plans, Sweep Tosho declares that she's going to change everyone's "lame" assumptions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, she plans to win the Triple Tiara. Then, in her senior year, she's going to change the world by defeating the Triple Crown tour runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the second race of the Triple Tiara tour—the Japanese Oaks. A fierce battle to decide the Queen of the Oaks awaits our little witch.
